DOMAIN_SYLLABI.mission: This is not a syllabus to finish u2014 it is a Software Engineering Growth System that runs for all 32 weeks. Nothing ends after learning: every concept flows through one continuous loop u2014 Learn u2192 Practice u2192 Build u2192 Document u2192 Review u2192 Share u2192 Apply u2192 Improve u2192 and repeat u2014 so each week's output becomes evidence and raw material for the next. Six tracks progress in parallel rather than in sequence: Programming Mastery (C u2192 C++ u2192 DSA), Python Engineering (from Week 1), Engineering Discipline (Git, Linux, testing, tooling u2014 every week), AI & Machine Learning (the career spine), Competitive Programming (continuous problem-solving), and Open Source & Portfolio (public proof from early on). You don't just study topics u2014 you ship projects at four levels, grow a real GitHub profile, write about what you learn, revise on a schedule, and leave an unbroken trail of proof of work. The goal is to graduate as a professional software and AI engineer with a portfolio that proves it, not a student who finished a course. One principle governs the whole track: real engineering before AI assistance u2014 you first build the ability to reason, debug, design, implement and optimise by hand, and only then let AI accelerate work you already understand. AI is a force multiplier here, never a substitute for competence, and success is always measured by demonstrable capability and proof of work rather than topics completed. Above the mechanics sits the real bar: this track exists to produce an engineer you would actually hire u2014 one who reads unfamiliar systems before changing them, chooses architectures, databases, frameworks and models with reasoned trade-offs rather than defaults, exercises judgement under uncertainty through root-cause analysis, post-mortems and design reviews, and can defend the why behind every decision.

DSA reaches design problems and timed mocks; you enter real contests (CodeChef / Codeforces / AtCoder); you open your first genuine pull request; Portfolio Projects go public with architecture diagrams and blog write-ups.

Real-World Application (W25u201332): product thinking, technical interviews, entrepreneurship, original research and the Flagship capstone. This domain is the STRATEGY layer: it defines the goal of each stage. learningOutcomes: Run a basic beginner-to-intermediate strength progression with correct form

progressionModel: Strategic 8-stage transformation cycle across 32 weeks (~4 weeks each). Every stage names a dominant strategic goal; the Nourish planner supplies the exact meals and workouts to execute it.
Stage 1 (W1–4) — DISCIPLINE & CONSISTENCY: show up daily. Walk, 7h sleep and 2.5L water become non-negotiable before any intensity is added.
Stage 2 (W5–8) — NUTRITION HABITS & FAT-LOSS BASE: dial in vegetarian protein and fibre and a small, sustainable deficit using the Nourish meal system — no crash dieting.
Stage 3 (W9–12) — STRENGTH FOUNDATION: a structured bodyweight→gym progression with real progressive overload begins.
Stage 4 (W13–16) — STAMINA & CONDITIONING: cardio base 3×/week; work capacity and daily energy rise, recovery watched.
Stage 5 (W17–20) — MOBILITY & STRUCTURED TRAINING: daily mobility, a structured split, and stress-aware training around study load.
Stage 6 (W21–24) — RECOVERY & PROGRESSIVE OVERLOAD: programmed rest and deloads; protein/fibre targets tightened and tracked.
Stage 7 (W25–28) — SUSTAINABILITY & BODY-COMPOSITION REVIEW: fine-tune from real data; reassess strength numbers and fat-loss progress.
Stage 8 (W29–32) — FOREVER ROUTINE: lock the minimum sustainable lifestyle and identity, final audit, forward plan.

DAY_MODE_POLICY.selection: Mode is chosen intentionally, ideally at the start of the day. Every selection and change is stored with a timestamp and a short reason.
DAY_MODE_POLICY.sameDayChange: A same-day change is legitimate when circumstances genuinely change (surprise class, illness, family call). Allowed while the day is still in progress AND fewer than half of the currently-visible tasks are completed; a downgrade after that point is recorded as an exception with its reason and flagged (not blocked) in Progress.
DAY_MODE_POLICY.retroactive: Never. A past day's mode is immutable — switching yesterday to College-Heavy to turn 40% into 100% is score manipulation, and the app must make it impossible.
DAY_MODE_POLICY.display: Progress shows mode history (with reasons) alongside Flex Days — visibility, not punishment.

DAY_MODE_RULES.selection: Mode is chosen intentionally at first app open of the day (default Full). Every selection and every change is stored as {date, from, to, timestamp, reason?}.
DAY_MODE_RULES.sameDayChanges: Legitimate same-day changes are allowed when circumstances genuinely change: switching to a HEAVIER mode is allowed any time; switching to a LIGHTER mode is allowed freely before the daily cutoff (default 6 PM, configurable).
DAY_MODE_RULES.lateDowngrade: After the cutoff, switching lighter is still possible (life happens) but requires a one-line reason and the day is stored with lateDowngrade: true — shown neutrally in Progress trends, never as a red flag.
DAY_MODE_RULES.noRetroactive: Mode can never be changed for a past day. The completion % recorded at midnight is final.

MASTERY_STATES.meaning: Passed again later from memory / applied in a project — durable.

HABITS.label: DSA: 1 problem (25–30 min) — this week's pattern
HABITS.note: Mon: learn pattern + guided problem · Tue–Fri: timed, no notes · Sat: re-solve weakest from memory. Sunday is review + reward, not grinding.

HABITS.label: Push ≥1 real commit — keep GitHub green
HABITS.note: Project code, DSA solutions repo, or your learning-log repo (private is fine — Wednesday pointers count). A green graph is a byproduct of daily building — never push empty commits. NEVER MISS TWICE.

HABITS.label: 20-min spaced revision of yesterday's learning
HABITS.note: Beats the forgetting curve. Re-read notes, re-run one snippet from memory.

HABITS.label: Read 30 min — current book / paper / newsletter
HABITS.note: WHAT to read comes from the current week's Knowledge assignment. Wednesday: turn it into 3 pointers and use one.

HABITS.label: Morning walk — 20 min
HABITS.note: The Week-1 baseline that never leaves. Counts as done via 20-min walk OR 6–8k total steps — movement snacks between classes add up.

HABITS.label: Fuel basics — 2.5L water + protein anchor at ≥2 mess meals
HABITS.note: Vegetarian protein anchors: dal (double serving), paneer, curd/yogurt, chana, rajma, soya chunks, sprouts, milk, peanuts. Tick the habit when you hit the water AND anchored at least two meals. Plate method: half veg/salad · quarter protein · quarter roti/rice — portions, not starvation.

HABITS.label: Sleep 7h+ (logged)
HABITS.note: From W7: consistent wake time, no screens 30 min before bed.

HABITS.label: Exercise session (gym / bodyweight)
HABITS.note: Evolves by phase: P1 (W2–8) 15–20-min bodyweight circuit · P2 (W9–16) full-body strength progression + 20-min cardio · P3 (W17–24) structured split (push/pull/legs) with progressive overload · P4 (W25–32) your sustainable forever routine. Pull-ups: negatives/assisted in P2 → full reps in P3. LOG the numbers (sets × reps × weight) — overload is data, not a vibe. FALLBACK: a 10-minute session still counts as a tick; consistency beats volume. NEVER MISS TWICE. CYCLE-AWARE: on high-symptom menstrual-cycle days the 10-minute mobility/walk fallback IS the intended session — autoregulate, never push through pain; strength naturally dips in some cycle phases and that is normal, not regression.

HABITS.label: 10-min mobility / posture routine
HABITS.note: Programmer insurance: neck, hips, wrists. After workouts on training days.

HABITS.label: Weekly review ritual — 20 min
HABITS.note: Satisfied by the Sunday Board Meeting task (its SCORE agenda item). Do it BEFORE the reward.

HABITS.label: Creator rep — 5–10 min low-stakes practice
HABITS.note: The skill rotates weekly (speaking → storytelling → writing → camera → editing → …). Reps, not perfection.

HABITS.label: Savings/SIP transfer — ₹100+
HABITS.note: Set as a bank AUTO-DEBIT in Week 2 so it cannot lapse — automation beats discipline for money.

HABITS.label: AI-leverage log — note 1 real problem spotted
HABITS.note: Yours, a classmate's, a local shop's — raw material for your flagship and freelance offers.

HABITS.label: Weekly body-trend review — weigh-in + one-line trend note (optional)
HABITS.note: Weekly, never daily — and judge the TREND, not one reading. Cycle-aware: weight can swing 1–2 kg from water retention around your period; compare week-over-week at a similar cycle phase where possible, and never treat a period-week uptick as fat gain.
